Hi Julia / Chris —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to hear about Medicore's rollout timeline and the specific latency/SLO concerns around the patient-facing inference path. Quick recap and a proposed next step:

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce model inference P95 latency to sub-250ms for the patient lookup flow.
- Constraint: on-prem connectors and strict logging/retention rules.
- Team: Chris (Platform Lead) + Julia (Dir. Eng) will be the core decision-makers; security will be involved later.

Proposed next step
- 60-minute technical deep dive with our solutions engineer (Soojin) to validate environment, network constraints, and run a short perf checklist / sample request trace.

Two windows I'm proposing (all times are EST):
1) Wed, Nov 11 — 10:00–11:00 AM EST (15:00–16:00 UTC)
2) Thu, Nov 12 — 02:00–03:00 PM EST (19:00–20:00 UTC)

Please reply with the preferred window and any additional attendees we should include. If neither works, suggest 1–2 alternate times and we'll pivot.

Bridge preference: Zoom (I included a tentative Zoom link in the follow-up invite I can send once we lock time). Google Meet is OK as a fallback.

Attachments: medicore-deepdive-proposal.ics (proposed slots/ICS)
Related doc: Mutual Action Plan (drive) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cMedicoreMAP

Next steps from my side once you confirm:
- Lock a calendar invite with the final bridge link and attendee roster.
- Send quick pre-read and a short agenda (30–40 minutes of demo/ops + 15–20 minutes Q&A).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
